# InsureFlow360 Custom Agents

This directory contains specialized agents for the InsureFlow360 Salesforce project.

## Available Agents

---

## How to Use

1. Open any file in the InsureFlow360 project
2. Open the Copilot Chat (Ctrl+Shift+I or Cmd+Shift+I)
3. Provide your development task or requirement
4. The agent will analyze the project and implement your request

## Project Standards

Mark follows these conventions:
- Apex class naming: `PascalCase` (e.g., `ClaimService`, `FraudDetectionQueueable`)
- Method naming: `camelCase`
- Test classes: `OriginalClassTest.cls`
- File location: `force-app/main/default/classes/`
- Approval processes: `force-app/main/default/approvalProcesses/`
- Flows & Workflows: `force-app/main/default/flows/` and `workflows/`
